en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie, or someone else, from Muhammad Bin Uzafar, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the charity upon the people of the valleys and the wilderness, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Give charity upon the children, and the women, and the sick, and the weak, and the old’; and he<sup>asws</sup> had forbidden from those who are able, meaning the ones with the (earning) capacity’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il ibn Bazi’ or someone other than him from Muhammad ibn ‘Adhafir from ‘Umar ibn Yazid who has said the following:

“I asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about giving charity to the Bedouins and people who live in remote areas. He replied, ‘Give charity to their children, women and people suffering from chronic illness, the weak and the old.’ He prohibited giving charity to those with big hairs (meaning thereby people hostile to ’A’immah).’’
